annotations.title: Invite a client to a brand

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Invites an external client to view one brand (client project), without joining the agency organization or seeing sibling brands. Use an id from list_brands and the client email. The connection needs write scope and its owner must be an org owner/admin. Only role viewer is supported; this does not grant approval, edit, publish or billing access. The invite expires after seven days. A pending duplicate is refused. success means the invite was created; check emailSent separately and relay a false value to the user.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/brands/{id}/invites.)

id.description: One organization brand id from GET /api/v2/brands; not personal or all.
